name: mstack
description: A product messaging workflow for turning release context into sharper updates, launch assets, and post-launch learning.

interface.shortDescription: Product messaging workflow for launches and updates.
interface.longDescription: mStack turns messy product context into a clear launch brief, pressure-tests the angle, drafts the update, critiques the copy, packages channel-specific launch assets, and captures reusable post-launch messaging lessons.
defaultPrompt: Collect launch context for this release.
Find the strongest angle for this update.
Turn this into a launch pack.
